source.citation: Ruling 29/38/39 ordinary all-cause mortality: SSA 2023 period life table hazard times recorded chronic-condition weights (data/research/health/chronic-condition-pack-2026.json) against one fixed strain threshold; src/simulation/crisis/mortality.ts, condition-pack.ts, death-causes.ts.
source.estimatedFrom: Pure helpers of the existing no-dice mortality rule, applied to core2 residents from the world's opening day; no seeded roll decides a death date.

gaps: Conditions that begin during life, coverage records and the below-poverty-line onset cause are not ported; only opening conditions and the serious-illness onset and death they lead to run.
Injury, sudden illness and births have no core2 producer yet.
Household income for the opening condition ranking uses recorded job pay; households without recorded pay sort as unknown, as in the old rule.
